part.text:
Implemented the Node HTTP adapter fix in `lib/adapters/http.js`.

Axios now explicitly passes `Infinity` to `follow-redirects` when `maxBodyLength` is the Axios default `-1`, preventing `follow-redirects` from silently enforcing its 10 MiB default. Explicit finite limits remain unchanged.

Validation:
- `mocha test/unit/adapters/http.js --grep "max body length"`: 2 passing
- `eslint lib/adapters/http.js`: passing
- Full HTTP adapter test file: 56 passing; 2 existing environment-sensitive failures unrelated to this change (`maxContentLength` expected response and HTTPS timeout).
